notes.title: Patch Notes 1.04 - Auto aim rework
notes.notes:
[h2]Auto-Aim Rework & Balance Changes: In this update, I’ve completely reworked the auto-aim system to improve accuracy and consistency across all weapons. Additionally, several balance changes have been made to enhance gameplay. Check out the details below![/h2]

Fixes:
[olist]
[*]Reworked auto-aim for (hopefully) all weapons. Still testing, so please report any issues.
[*]Auto-aim settings now save correctly.
[*]Fixed the AoE size for the Grenade Launcher.
[*]Fixed the reload animation spam issue when using Sticky Bomb.
[*]Fixed crash related to the Phantom Disruptor.
[*]Corrected attack speed scaling for the Shouting ability.
[*]Resolved sound stacking issue with the Chainsaw.
[*]Fixed the Firehose bug where fuel wasn’t being consumed.
[*]Kunai now behave as intended, being thrown in three directions.
[*]Fixed crashes caused by Shurikens.
[*]Summons now scale properly with attack speed.
[*]Fixed the Sticky Bomb description.
[*]Made visual tweaks to the class selection screen.
[*]Fixed the functionality of the Book weapon.
[*]Addressed issues with Zeus' Blessing:
[list][*]Summons now properly use the blessing.
[*]Fuel weapons can cast Zeus' Blessing every 1 second.[/list]
[*]Corrected max HP values for all classes.
[*]Fixed roll input for the keyboard.
[/olist]
Balance Changes:
[olist]
[*]Laser Glasses base damage reduced from 0.5 -> 0.1.
[*]SMG base damage increased from 0.5 -> 0.7.
[*]Shouting base attack speed increased from 1 -> 4.
[*]Shouting base damage reduced from 0.25 -> 0.20.
[*]Firehose base damage reduced from 0.5 -> 0.2.
[*]Firehose startup speed increased by 2x.
[*]Double Axe base damage reduced from 6 -> 2.
[*]Kunai base damage reduced from 2.5 -> 1.75.
[*]Shurikens starting ammo reduced from 6 -> 3.
[*]RPG base damage reduced from 5 -> 3.
[*]Summons base damage increased from 1 -> 1.75.
[*]Summons attack speed reduced from 3 -> 2.
[*]Sword base attack speed reduced from 2 -> 1.
[/olist]

[h3]Dedicated summons upgrades are coming soon!

Thanks for playing and for all your feedback! Let me know how these changes feel, and keep the suggestions coming. See you in GunBang![/h3]

notes.title: GunBang Patch Notes 1.03
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone! The 1.03 update brings some exciting changes, including a full input rework, a fully functional Linux build, and a few smaller updates. Check out what’s new:[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Instant upgrade purchases – You can now instantly buy upgrades with a right-click on the mouse or RB on the gamepad.
[*]Optimized button navigation – Navigating menus with a keyboard or gamepad should feel much smoother now.
[*]DualShock and expanded gamepad support – Added support for DualShock controllers, and possibly even more gamepads (if everything works as expected).
[*]Roll with LB on gamepad – You can now roll using the LB button on your gamepad for more intuitive controls.
[*]Improved input recognition – I’ve made improvements to better detect whether you’re using a gamepad or a mouse (hopefully this works more reliably).
[/olist]

[h3]Thanks for playing and for all your feedback! Let me know how these changes feel, and keep the suggestions coming. See you in GunBang![/h3]

notes.title: GunBang Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone! I’ve been hard at work improving GunBang, and I’m excited to share the latest update with you all. Here’s what’s new:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added damage text for fire element – You’ll now see damage numbers when hitting enemies with fire element.
[*]Added immunity time during rolling – Rolling now grants a brief invincibility period, making dodging more effective.
[*]Fixed Shouting weapon unlocking bug.
[*]Potential fix for mushroom boss attacks – I’ve worked on fixing a bug with mushroom boss attacks. Let me know if it’s better!
[*]Sniper weapon change – Increased sniper bullet count from 1 to 5.
[*]Sword base damage adjusted – Reduced sword damage from 3 to 2.
[*]Fixed ranged enemies not dealing damage – Ranged enemies should now deal damage properly in combat.
[*]Added immunity frame to roll – You’ll now have a brief invincibility frame when rolling to help avoid attacks.
[*]Added immunity time after taking damage – After getting hit, you’ll be invincible for a short time to recover.
[*]Fixed roll stopping issue – Resolved the issue where the character would stop after rolling.
[*]Increased enemy bullet size – Some enemies’ bullet sizes have been increased from 1.0x to 1.5x for better visibility.
[*]Fixed carrot hit animation – The hit animation for the carrot enemy has been fixed and should now display correctly.
[/list]
Thanks for all your feedback and support! Keep those bug reports and ideas coming, and I’ll keep improving GunBang. See you in the game!
